_doc: [v6story] Story text that has no other home (docs/STORY_VERDANCE.md). goal_reasons: the one-line in-world reason shown on the objective card above a goal's reward (story/objectives.gd goal_reason): by goal id, else by id prefix (by_prefix), else by kind ("type:key" of the goals.json entry), else by type, else `default`. Goals can be added, moved or re-priced in data/goals.json without touching this file. exit: WREN's lines when the Orbital drive is built (drive_built), spoken once (systems/homeward_director.gd). [v7arc] The lines when the way onward opens are each planet's story block in data/story_arc.json. Data stays English; tr() at display.

goal_reasons.default: One more step toward a green world.

by_id.home_land_1: You can fly on now. The rest of Verdance can wait.
by_id.rocket: Other old stations are waiting to be woken up.
by_id.hub_fly_2: The seed tin is nearly empty. Garden Row kept the seed store.
by_id.hub_fly_3: The rocket's skin is too thin for space. Gantry Works made hulls.
by_id.hub_fly_4: Nobody knows where to fly. Signal Heights kept the star chart.
by_id.hub_fly_5: A long flight needs lasting power. The Fairground has a cell.
by_id.hub_fly_6: The rocket's tanks are empty. Stack Works still has fuel.
by_id.hub_wake_3: Wake the Gantry Crane: its hull plates shield the rocket.
by_id.hub_wake_4: Wake the Signal Mast: it holds the star chart.
by_id.hub_wake_5: Wake the Big Wheel: its power cell lasts the long flight.
by_id.hub_wake_6: Wake the Tall Stack. Its tanks still hold fuel for the rocket.
by_id.base2_3: A strong second base keeps its side of Verdance clean.
by_id.base2_4: A strong second base keeps its side of Verdance clean.

drive_built: The rocket can leave now. Verdance isn't finished, and that's all right.
Some of its trash needs tools the Settlers left on other worlds. We'll bring them back.
